title: How Property Tax Exemptions for Seniors Work by State
bigPicture: Seniors may qualify for a property tax exemption, but each state has its own rules.
whatYouNeedToKnow: Your state sets a minimum age and sometimes an income limit to qualify.
You must apply each year; the paperwork is usually short.
The exemption lowers your tax amount, but it does not erase all taxes.
commonMistakesToAvoid: Thinking the exemption is automatic and you don't need to apply.
Believing the exemption covers all taxes, like school or city fees.
actionSteps: Visit your state's tax website or call the local assessor's office to learn the rules.
Gather proof of age and income, then submit the application before the deadline.
